task_description.overview: Compute and plot seismic ray paths in Cartesian coordinates for specified epicentral distance and phases using a velocity model.
steps: Load the seismic velocity model (e.g., iasp91).
Define source depth, epicentral distance, and phases of interest.
Calculate ray path trajectories using travel-time solver.
Plot the ray paths on a Cartesian map projection.
Customize legend and visibility of all rays.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Plot the seismic ray paths in Cartesian coordinates for epicentral distance 140° at source depth 500 km. Use the iasp91 velocity model and include phases PP and SSS. Output should a figure with the Cartesian ray paths drawn ('distance(°)-depth(km)' relationship). 
 Note: 1) the TauPyModel provide `get_ray_paths` to compute the rays and `arrivals.plot_rays` to plot the rays. 
 2) Save the ray path plot to {result_plot}.
